name: John Deere North American Parts Distribution Center - Milan IL

fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, gate, or controlled checkpoint observed at the property-line entrance. The DC is accessed via a wide private entrance drive off the north arterial road; the drive is open at the street (z20 satellite and 2019/2025 Street View). The office entrance at the NE is a circular drive with no control. A facility this large likely has internal gates at the dock yard, but no street-level controlled gate was visible - classified false on visible evidence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth observed at the property-line entrance or office entrance. Web tips mention drivers referencing 'gate' numbers (e.g. Gate 4), suggesting internal gate stations exist, but none was confirmed as a staffed booth at a property-line truck entrance.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - no controlled truck gate at the property line was confirmed (precondition not met).
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved staging areas on the building's east face / dock yard before the dock doors.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long private entrance drive and an extensive internal dock-side road can stack many trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Ample paved width and a wide entrance apron at the open entrance drive - physical room for express/bypass lanes.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+: the 2.8M sq ft DC has a continuous dock bank running the full length of the building's east face with trailers backed in along its entire length. Estimated ~90 doors - high-confidence band, lower-confidence exact count.
fieldNotes.dropArea / dropYard: 50+: enormous trailer drop yards along the building's east and south sides - z19 imagery shows hundreds of parked trailers in long rows plus intermodal containers. One of the largest trailer-staging operations observed.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity concentrated on the building's east face; no clearly separate shipping vs. receiving dock clusters on different faces observed - set false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Milan IL is a small town (~5,000 pop) on the Quad Cities metro edge; the DC is surrounded by farmland to the south, residential to the east, and a highway/interchange to the NW. Per the rubric's small-town / edge-of-town guidance, classified Rural.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale / weigh platform observed in the truck path.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: One DC building (plus an attached office wing); not a multi-building campus - false.
fieldNotes.railServed: No active rail spur observed entering the property - railServed false.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~350 is an estimate from overhead imagery of the very large drop yards; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: ~500 - the drop yards are extensive with room for very high trailer counts; honest estimate.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 2 lanes at the wide open entrance drive; no formal gate lanes - low confidence.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~215 acres - the 2.8M sq ft building footprint (~64 acres) plus extensive trailer drop yards, parking, pond, and grounds. Perimeter bounding box ~265 acres includes some undeveloped margin.
